title: Daily reports and the production log are separate
description:
Daily Reports and the older production log were sharing one tab, so the footage log sat on top of the new job reports.

Daily Reports now shows only the assigned job for that day: time logs, images, problems, who was notified, and the plan PDF. The older footage log, including manager notes tied to a calendar day, moved to its own Production log tab next to Daily Reports. Admins still see that log. Crew members and customers do not.

Who is affected: the private server and SaaS after this version is pushed. Schedule, Planner, Crew Hub, Contacts, and My job are unchanged. The desktop app gets the same split in its own installer.
changeLog: Daily Reports shows only the assigned-job report for the day you pick.
The older footage production log moved to its own Production log tab.
Admins still see the production log. It no longer covers Daily Reports.
Schedule, Planner, Crew Hub, Contacts, and My job stay where they were.
